chapters.title: Chapter 355 - The wedding (02)
paragraphs: Soon after talking to Tai'Ren, Qingyi was guided by some servants to a large, luxurious room.
There, his clothes were changed into a long golden robe, different from the leather robes the cat people used to wear.
His long black hair was carefully combed, decorated with golden pendants, and a steel crown was placed on his head.
Even though he knew how these ceremonies worked, at least to some extent, it was strange for Qingyi to see himself looking so different.
When all the decorations were finished, he followed the servants through wide corridors until they finally reached the cat people's feast hall.
It was the largest of all, with a capacity for thousands of guests.
Wealthy merchants, great noble families and even foreign ambassadors - all the elite of the cat folk's capital were gathered, their eyes fixed on Qingyi.
He was already well known. Rumors about his deeds spread like wildfire, reaching even distant settlements.
An ascended from the mortal heavens, winner of the great hunt and the young talent who killed an immortal emperor while only being in the flowing meridian realm.
Even though this immortal emperor had suppressed his cultivation for that fight, it mattered little to the common people.
To them, Qingyi was simply a legend.
Qingyi walked calmly to a large staircase where, at the top, there were two thrones.
On one of them, Tai'Ren was sitting, and on the other, his main wife and Linyue's mother, a quiet and reserved woman whose cultivation was at the peak of the Immortal Emperor realm.
"Qingyi greets father-in-law and mother-in-law," said the handsome young man, bowing and kneeling in front of his in-laws.
The moment his voice echoed, a loud bang sounded and the large double doors of the room, previously firmly closed, swung open, revealing a breathtaking figure.
It was Linyue, not in her usual leather attire, always ready for the hunt. Now, she wore a golden silk dress, similar to Qingyi's.
Thin strands of gold surrounded her ears and feline tail, and her movements caused a soft tinkling sound to spread throughout the room.
Watching her beautiful face, with slightly trembling eyes, Qingyi could see exactly what was going through Linyue's head.
She couldn't wait to have the chance to finally take off those uncomfortable, tight clothes. She wanted her clothes back!
"Ah... that's how she is..." Qingyi disguised his bitter smile with a sweet smile, waiting for her to come to his side.
"Linyue greets father and mother," she said, kneeling down next to Qingyi and taking his hand.
Tai'Ren cleared his throat and stood up, staring at the young couple before raising his gaze to the guests.
"A few weeks ago, I decided it was time for my little Linyue to finally get married. With the great hunt, I hoped to find a great hunter, a man of power worthy of my daughter.
Fortunately, I found someone even better, a young man capable not only of crossing several kingdoms, but also of accomplishing incomparable feats.
May the heavens bless this marriage and may their love be eternal!" Tai'Ren raised his glass of liquor, and all the guests did the same soon after.
Turning his face away, he beckoned his wife to stand up.
She approached Qingyi and bent down. Her beautiful middle-aged face revealed a gentle smile as she held his hands.
"Long Qingyi, do you promise to always love and protect my daughter, to allow no harm to come to her and to make all her enemies your enemies?" asked Linyue's mother.
"I promise," Qingyi replied firmly.
"Good..." She turned her face, staring at her daughter. "You look so beautiful, I can't believe you're already leaving me to run away with this young dragon..."
"I'm not running away... and he said he'd bring me here to see you whenever I want," Linyue blushed, looking away.
"If he breaks that promise, let me know. I'll teach him not to hurt my little girl, fufufu~~" Linyue's mother giggled, getting up and returning to her husband's side.
Qingyi could only shudder, a chill running down his spine. He didn't know what the threat was, but he certainly didn't like it.
He might despise that promise if it came from anyone else, but not from the mother of one of his wives.
"May the heavens bless this marriage and may their love be eternal," declared Linyue's mother, a little less firmly than her husband, with all the elegance expected of a woman of her level.

Tai'Ren signaled for them both to stand up and then spoke: "With a kiss, this marriage will be sealed. Long Qingyi, young dragon, slayer of immortals, will be not just a stranger, but a true member of our family."
Qingyi's face darkened a little when he heard those titles. Tai'Ren really wanted his son-in-law to be known this way?
'Well... slayer of immortals isn't bad... it could be a lot worse...' Qingyi shook his head and finally turned to Linyue.
After a moment of staring at each other, the two finally kissed. Their lips intertwined in a contact that lasted long seconds and ended with an explosion of celebrations throughout the room.
From the top of the hall, the skies opened up and moonlight fell on the two of them.
A strange but pleasant Qi coursed through Qingyi and Linyue's bodies.
Even those opposed to the wedding stood up to clap for the couple.
Naturally, the ceremony didn't stop there.

Qingyi had to receive the wedding gifts and offer the dowry to the bride's family, choosing to spend a large amount of lust points on pills that might help his father-in-law reach the realm of the astral body.

He honestly didn't know how rare those pills were for cultivators of the ancestral emperor realm, but seeing the change on Tai'Ren's face when he received them, Qingyi realized that it was a fitting gift.
After the main dinner and all the long speeches congratulating the couple, they were finally released for their wedding night, returning to Linyue's room, which had been perfectly prepared for it.
"Ugh... I hate that thing, Nyan! Nyan! Nyan!" Linyue repeated, as she grabbed the dress.
She didn't even take it off, she simply tore it.
By the time she turned to Qingyi, she was completely naked, throwing herself into his arms.

"That wasn't so bad, was it?" Qingyi smiled, lying down on the bed with her. "Do you really think it would have been worth it to have captured me and accused me of being a pleasure demon in front of your father?"
"Nyan. Of course it would! I could be hunting right now! Hehehe," she giggled, drawing a gasp from Qingyi.
This girl...

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - Other wives
paragraphs: The divine beast tournament was one of the most famous and prestigious in the entire land of beastmen, a place where dozens of tribes gathered from the venomous snake folk to the swift cat folk and even the incomparable dragon folk.
Everyone there had a single goal: the chance to obtain the blessing of the fox folk, the rarest and most hidden of all the hundreds of folk in the land of beast men.
Obviously, this wasn't easy to achieve.

Only a thousand young people would even have the chance to take part in the qualifying rounds of the tournament. Less than 100 would take part in the main part and, of these, only two would be champion.
These first thousand would be divided between recommended participants from the major tribes of the beast folks and the commoners, who could only rely on a random selection system.
It came as a great surprise to everyone when Tai'Ren, lord of the cat folk, announced that one of his folk's five places had been given to his son-in-law.
That was a slot that had originally belonged to Lioran, so no one complained too much about that part.
The problem was that the seat had been offered to someone who wasn't from the cat people.
Even with the wedding, everyone still recognized Qingyi as a young dragon and nothing more.
"Ah... they seem pretty angry..." Qingyi muttered, looking out of the window of a colossal flying ship, his eyes sweeping over the elders arguing with Tai'Ren.
Obviously, none of them had even come close to convincing his father-in-law to change his choice.
They only fell silent when Tai'Ren finally said that, if such questioning continued, he would make them fight Qingyi with their cultivations sealed.
No one had the courage to say anything else after that.
"Nyan, these old bastards don't know what's good for them!" Linyue climbed onto Qingyi's lap, looking out of the window and showing her tongue to the angry elders below.
They couldn't see her, but if they did, they would surely be spitting blood.
"Yes, They don't," Qingyi let a small laugh escape his lips, patting Linyue on the ass to make her sit up straight.

This was the Cat Folk's primary flying ship, a colossus of luxury produced by the most skilled shipbuilders of the five-colored pavilion, a ten-thousand-year anniversary gift that Tai'Ren had received from the Gold King himself.
Naturally, Qingyi and Linyue had their own private room, but right now, they were in the dining area, waiting until it was time to finally leave.
Closing his eyes briefly, Qingyi remembered what he had heard from the dragon people since arriving in this place.
There were less than a thousand of them in total, a tiny number compared to populations that ran into the millions, perhaps tens of millions among other tribes.
The cat folk alone numbered fifteen million, counting the capital and all the outlying cities.

A single movement, small and smooth, but the whole world around them changed, space distorting violently.
By the time Qingyi realized it, they were all standing in front of a large golden palace, built at the base of a huge statue of a golden dragon, whose shadow hid the entire city below.

He was the only one there below this realm and naturally received many looks of contempt, especially from the arrogant dragons.
"Uncomfortable?" Tianjin asked, turning his face slightly towards Qingyi.

Those words drew soft laughter from both Tai'Ren and Tianjin.

One of them, Qingyi quickly recognized: Long Xuefeng, a young man with white dragon blood whom he had very cheerfully beaten up with Lioran.
'So... the other one must be his older brother.' Qingyi thought.
"These are some of the greatest talents of this generation of my people," Tianjin spoke up. "Long Xuefeng, Long Jinrui, show our guests to their rooms, I have important business to attend to."
"Yes, patriarch." They both bowed at the same time, Xuefeng's voice coming out slurred and angry, unlike his brother's, which was cold and disinterested.
"If you're going to cause trouble, avoid killing or crippling." Tai'Ren patted Qingyi on the shoulder.
"Don't put my baby at risk..." Linyue's mother passed him soon after, messing up his hair before following behind her husband.
Watching the two of them follow Tianjin, Qingyi just smiled.
Fortunately, he had good parents-in-law.
Shaking his head, he looked up at Xuefeng.
There were dozens of people in the cat people's entourage, many young talents and powerful guards, but Xuefeng's gaze was only on Qingyi, no one else.
"Young master Xuefeng... I hope I haven't hurt your fragile pride too much... it was an honorable fight."
"Honorable fight? You..." Xuefeng swallowed his anger before turning away, his eyes blazing.

"Ah... do you have something against my brother, Young Master Qingyi? I've heard rumors about your accomplishments and I'm anxious to see if it's all true, hahaha." Jinrui laughed, not even paying attention to his younger brother's tantrum.
"We just had a little dispute and well, I came out on top," Qingyi returned Jinrui's laugh, offering a firm handshake.
"Well, my brother is that kind of person..." Jinrui shook his head, turning and signaling for everyone to follow him.
Many of the cat people's young talents were uncomfortable seeing Qingyi as the sole center of attention, but in the end, what could they do about it?
Throw themselves on the ground and cry?
They just followed silently.
"Nyan, I don't like this one..." Linyue spoke, holding onto Qingyi a little tighter, sticking out her tongue at the figure on Jinrui's back.
The young dragon stopped for a moment, the delicate, dignified features of his masculine face distorting briefly before he continued walking, his shoulders shaking gently.
After a moment to calm his breathing, Jinrui turned his face slightly, his voice cold and dripping with venom.
"My mother once gave me a pet kitten, small, cute, but very cheeky. One day, it spilled ink on a poem I was preparing for my master...
Do you know what I did with it?"
After getting no response, he continued.

"I broke his little legs, then tore off his tail, collapsed his lungs and, in the end, broke his neck. I was careful to keep him alive until the end." Jinrui smiled, his face exuding nothing but incomparable purity and kindness.
Linyue immediately hid behind Qingyi, every hair on her tail standing up.
"Be careful, young master Jinrui," Qingyi smiled back. "I'm a great lover of cats, just as I'm a great lover of breaking bones and ripping out teeth."
"I'll be careful, hahaha," Jinrui laughed, barely paying attention to Qingyi before continuing to guide them through the grand and luxurious corridors of the golden mansion.
The handsome young man could only sigh.
His first impression of Jinrui had been rather positive compared to the one he had of Xuefeng, but in the end, they were fruit from the same tree.

Qingyi continued to study those lines of Qi for a brief moment before closing his eyes, feeling a subtle headache coming on.

After a moment, he started walking, a little aimlessly at first, but soon gained direction when a powerful pulse of Qi spread throughout the miniature world.

paragraphs: "Long Qianyao"
The moment he heard that name, Qingyi raised his head, interrupting his silent meditation.
Finally, a fight he was interested in.
With one smooth movement, Qianyao took to the air, landing elegantly on one side of the large silver concrete platform.
Her beautiful golden eyes analyzed her opponent coldly while her slender, delicate fingers moved to the handle of her enormous sword, holding it firmly.
Her opponent landed silently on the other side of the platform. Long, pure white wings appeared on his back, their gentle beats making the air around him move as his long golden hair fluttered.
He was a member of the eagle people, a young man of great arrogance and beauty.

"Young Miss Qianyao, I apologize for my rudeness, but don't feel bad... I can buy you a nice meal when we're done." The young man from the eagle people flashed a big smile, but Qianyao's face remained impassive.
It was as if she only had an annoying insect screaming at her.
The young eagle's face darkened slightly, but he suppressed his bitterness.
What woman could resist him?
He readied himself, his wings flapping violently, his figure turning into nothing but an obscure blur.
'I just need to show her my power,' the young man thought, a dagger appearing in his hand as his body appeared next to Qianyao.
The second before he hit her, Qianyao turned her face, moving her huge sword at an absurd speed, a slight hint of contempt appearing on her lips.
The young man from the eagle people barely had time to react. A deep pain reached his head, his whole body being thrown to the ground by a power of tons.
The marble beneath his feet cracked, forming a deep crater.
"Weak..." Qianyao muttered coldly, drawing the sword to herself again and leaving that young man's unconscious figure behind.
That had been a shameful defeat, enough to make the patriarch of the eagle people next to Tai'Ren cover his face in shame and disappointment.
His son hadn't even been able to use his bloodline, defeated with a single blow from the side of Qianyao's sword.
She hadn't even used the edge of the blade! Why did she have to defeat him so disrespectfully?
"Get rid of the bad seeds, my friend. Your younger son looks much more promising than this one.
Does he even train? Or does he just hang out with prostitutes all day?" Tai'Ren patted his friend on the shoulder, who just sighed.
Tai'Ren wasn't wrong.
Qingyi, unaware of this exchange, just watched Qianyao return to where the other competitors were.
Her body landing elegantly next to him, her natural floral fragrance immediately enveloping him.
They didn't exchange a word, just watching the battles unfold.

Naturally, these were high-level battles between immortal heaven geniuses, all with at least mortal-grade lineages and some, the rarest and most powerful, with sky-grade and even transcendent-grade lineages.
Qingyi's next enemy was one of these incomparable talents, a young man from the lion people, great allies of the cat people.
He had sharp claws and long golden hair that surrounded his face like a beautiful, elegant mane. His body was much taller and more powerful than the average cat beastman.
"I've heard rumors about you..." The young lion whispered, raising a single hand. A mighty axe appeared in his grip as he landed on the platform.
"It's not just anyone who could screw with that bastard Lioran and his father."
"Annoying flies," Qingyi replied, landing on the opposite side and drawing his heaven-defying thunder sword.
"Annoying flies? Hahahaha!" The young lion laughed. "It's not just anyone who has the nerve to talk like that about an expert from the Immortal Emperor realm."
His handsome, brutish face revealed a friendly smile. "I like you. Don't let me down."
On his back, the huge figure of a lion with a flaming golden coat appeared.
Its thunderous roar took over the arena, only suppressed when Qingyi also acted, calling out to his own lineage.

In the next moment, they both advanced. Qingyi's body turned into lightning while the young lion's body was engulfed in flames.
The two met exactly in the middle of the arena. The impact between the heaven-defying thunder sword and the young lion's axe created a devastating shockwave.
"Ugh... to overcome such a difference in cultivation and even bloodline... You really are a heaven-chosen genius, aren't you? Hahaha!" The young lion laughed.
His muscles were burning, all his power focused on that single attack.
The metal of his axe was already showing signs of weakness in the face of the heaven-defying thunder sword, covered in sword Qi and lightning Qi.

He had sharp claws and long golden hair that surrounded his face like a beautiful, elegant mane.
His body was much taller and more powerful than the average cat beastman.
"I've heard rumors about you..." The young lion whispered, raising a single hand.
A mighty axe appeared in his grip as he landed on the platform.
"It's not just anyone who could screw with that bastard Lioran and his father."
"Annoying flies," Qingyi replied, landing on the opposite side and drawing his heaven-defying thunder sword.
"Annoying flies?
Hahahaha!" The young lion laughed.
"It's not just anyone who has the nerve to talk like that about an expert from the Immortal Emperor realm."
His handsome, brutish face revealed a friendly smile.
"I like you.
Don't let me down."
On his back, the huge figure of a lion with a flaming golden coat appeared.
Its thunderous roar took over the arena, only suppressed when Qingyi also acted, calling out to his own lineage.
"I should be the one to say that." Qingyi returned the smile, the black dragon appearing with equal majesty.
Its roar was superior to the lion's, its beautiful purple eyes sweeping over everyone there, as deep as Qingyi's own.
In the next moment, they both advanced.
Qingyi's body turned into lightning while the young lion's body was engulfed in flames.
The two met exactly in the middle of the arena.
The impact between the heaven-defying thunder sword and the young lion's axe created a devastating shockwave.
"Ugh... to overcome such a difference in cultivation and even bloodline...
You really are a heaven-chosen genius, aren't you?
Hahaha!" The young lion laughed.
His muscles were burning, all his power focused on that single attack.
The metal of his axe was already showing signs of weakness in the face of the heaven-defying thunder sword, covered in sword Qi and lightning Qi.
"I wouldn't consider myself to be chosen by the heavens, hahaha," Qingyi gave a muffled chuckle, also feeling the pressure.

The lineage of the dragon god of corruption was practically invincible, even against lineages of higher level, but it was still frustrating to fight against people of higher cultivation and similar grade.
Putting all his strength out, he covered his body with black scales, pushing the young lion back and retreating.
He readied his sword, with the power of lightning gathering around it without stopping.
That wasn't a skill he had learned, just something Qingyi wanted to test.

He carefully controlled the flow of Qi around his sword, keeping all the sword's Qi exactly at the sharp point while the lightning Qi took over the rest of the blade, strengthening it as much as possible.
Underneath it all, he moved his Qi of fire, focusing on heating the blade as much as he could.
The purplish-silver metal soon took on a slightly reddish color.
'Can you take it, Ruxue?' Qingyi asked mentally.
"That's the best steel in heaven, don't worry about the heat, fufufu~~." Ruxue replied, her intoxicatingly sweet laugh taking over Qingyi's mind.
Unfortunately, he didn't have much time to enjoy it and soon realized that the young lion was also preparing something.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - Tournament (04)
paragraphs: The young lion took to the air, flying just a few meters off the ground. His arms opened wide as his body changed, taken over by bestial features.
A dense fur covered his skin, his muscles expanded and his claws and fangs grew.
His axe was seized by an increasingly powerful flaming Qi, every drop of his being being poured into that single attack.
"Do you want to finish this with just one strike?" The young lion asked, the air around him boiling with power.
"Hm... yes." Qingyi smiled in response, turning his face briefly, his beautiful purple eyes meeting Qianyao's golden ones.
The beauty was totally focused on his sword, her already bright golden eyes becoming even more intense.
After a brief moment, Qingyi focused on his opponent again, finished preparing his attack and then advanced.
"Don't dodge, young dragon!" The lion roared, raising his axe over his head and dropping it towards Qingyi.
A lion of fire followed his movement, its body stretching like a serpent. Its silent roar silenced all onlookers.
The power was terrifying, but Qingyi didn't even flinch, confident in his own attack. His sword cut through the air in a downward swing.
When the blades met, a dry crack took over the arena, followed by a cloud of dust and a powerful shockwave. The metallic clang echoed in everyone's ears.
The spectators without high cultivation or cultivation techniques leaned in to get a better look, while the faces of the strongest were filled with shock.
"I-impossible..." The young lion's hoarse, powerful voice echoed as he fell to his knees, looking at the blade of his axe.
The blade had been cut perfectly in two. Not the wood handle, the blade.
The metal at the site of the cut was molten, taking on a vibrant, luminous red. The drops of blood that left the young lion's open chest fell onto them and immediately began to boil.
"Truly worthy of the... slayer of immortals, hahaha..." A last muffled laugh echoed from the young lion's lips before he leaned on the handle of his weapon and simply declared defeat.
He could keep fighting, but honestly, it wasn't worth it.
As well as cutting his axe, Qingyi's sword had also opened a deep cut in his chest and damaged some important meridians; that needed to be dealt with as soon as possible.
Sheathing the heaven-defying thunder sword, Qingyi just watched as the young lion was led away.
A sigh of defeat escaped his lips.
Had the nickname 'slayer of immortals' really come all that way?
"Ah... it could be worse..." Qingyi sighed and, with a smooth movement, jumped back to where the other competitors were waiting, landing next to Qianyao.

"A very interesting technique, what's its name, young master 'slayer of immortals'? Fufufu~~" The golden-eyed beauty gave a short, low and elegant laugh, covering her mouth with her small, delicate hand.
She could feel Long Jinrui's eyes piercing her back, all his murderous intent falling on Qingyi, but she just ignored him.
For both of them, treating him like an insignificant cockroach was far better than actively responding to him.
Qingyi returned Qianyao's laugh before replying: "I don't know yet, just something new I've just tried out, I don't even think it can be considered a technique, hahaha."
He scratched the back of his head, his mind wandering elsewhere as his eyes passed Qianyao's cleavage, admiring her huge, beautiful, heavy pale tits.
He didn't even notice her blush as she hugged her own chest, her fingers sinking into the voluptuous flesh as she looked away.
No matter how long she stayed by Qingyi's side, she simply couldn't get used to it.
It was so... strange.
'I think I can take some time to refine this and maybe create my first technique...', Qingyi thought, finally taking his eyes off Qianyao's breasts, watching the next battle with disinterest.
The result had been much better than he had expected.
If he took a few days to enter his sea of mind and cultivate that skill without stopping, perhaps he could increase his potency even more.

With Ruxue's help, he was sure that he would be able to create a technique of his own that was no less powerful than his strongest ones today, one that was totally focused on cutting through metal and destroying his enemy's weapons.
'Hm... I like this idea...', Qingyi thought.
Unfortunately, he didn't have much time to organize everything and soon it was Long Jinrui's turn to fight.
Finally, the young man from the dragon people managed to unleash some of his anger against his poor opponent, leaving him on the brink of death.
If Elder Yu hadn't interrupted, the young white dragon would certainly have killed his opponent.
Soon after his battle, another ten fights followed until it was Qianyao's turn, who again, with a single blow, defeated her opponent.
She swung her huge sword with an elegance and power that simply didn't seem to suit her.
The same went for all her opponents after that, as Qingyi destroyed blades one after the other, forcing his enemies to surrender.
Some retreated at the mere presence of the black dragon.
Jinrui, on the other hand, continued to beat his opponents almost to death, brutally spanking them.
He even chose to be the one to take on more than one battle in the same round to help adjust the numbers of players.

That tournament didn't have perfect numbers because its creator, many hundreds of thousands of years ago, made a mistake when defining the terms of the tournament that would decide those who could receive the blessing of the rare fox people.
Since no one dared to change this ancestor's words, they had to adapt to those rules.
Of course, now it didn't matter anymore.
The numbers of competitors had been drastically reduced after dozens of fights and soon, Qingyi's name was called.
His challenger was already standing in the arena, which was slowly regenerating from the previous fight.
That would be the last fight before he could finally face Jinrui.
Note: Yes, I was this ancestor and only realized the shit I did when it was too late to change, hahahaha.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - Tournament (05)
paragraphs: "Long Qingyi, step forward." Elder Yu's voice echoed throughout the arena, cheering up the spectators.
The battles had been raging for hours and countless liters of blood had bathed the arena. Now, there were only a few participants left.
Of these, only two would be chosen to receive the blessing of the fox people and, in the end, only one would be the great winner.
Qingyi landed on the arena and immediately raised his face, observing his opponent.
She was a woman of fragile appearance and lovely beauty, with few curves and large blue eyes, her cheeks slightly flushed.
Despite her fragile exterior, Qingyi was not fooled.
She was from the snake people, an incomparable talent in poison and shadow Qi, leaving each of her opponents on the brink of death.
Unfortunately for her, Qingyi was the worst enemy she could face.
His constitution was immune to basically all types of poison, with the exception of a handful that existed only in the celestial heavens and was used to kill gods.
The moment the battle began, she lunged forward, her body transforming into a myriad of snakes that scattered across the ground, jaws open towards Qingyi.
The handsome young man neither moved nor defended himself. His eyes glowed a deep purple as he allowed them all to bite him.
Naturally, many faces darkened in the spectators.
Didn't Qingyi see what happened when the other participants came into contact with that poisonous woman? Was he planning to surrender?

At that moment, Qingyi smiled. His whole body was seized by a burning heat as the Qi of flames and lightning surged simultaneously. His hands went straight to the neck of one of the snakes, gripping it tightly.

All the other snakes immediately broke into particles of light. The one in his hands struggled for long moments before finally changing shape, returning to its human form and gripping Qingyi's arm tightly.
'Try a better strategy next time.' Qingyi smiled before throwing her out of the arena. Her small, delicate body hit the golden wall with a thud.
Just a brief circulation of his Qi and all the bite marks disappeared. The poison in his bloodstream left his body in a mist of vapor.
He just sighed, looking at where the last competitors were.
Qianyao had already fought the semi-finals on her side and now, only Long Qingyi and Long Jinrui remained.
"Long Qingyi, do you need a moment to rest?" Elder Yu asked the handsome young man, who just shook his head.
"It's not necessary, elder. But if young master Long Jinrui needs to prepare further, I'll wait."
Jinrui's eyes blazed when he heard those words and without even being asked, he jumped into the arena.
Even there, Qingyi dared to despise him, dared to disrespect him!
He would make that damn pretty face swallow that arrogance with bones, flesh and blood!
Elder Yu just shook his head, going to the heavens and raising a single hand.
"Fight."
The moment his voice fell, the two of them turned into blackened blurs. Their bodies disappeared before reappearing exactly in the center of the arena, their swords meeting.
A metallic clang and a sea of sparks spread throughout the arena.
Jinrui was forced to take twenty steps backwards while Qingyi took fifteen.
'As expected... he's weaker than Qianyao...' Qingyi flashed a gentle smile, unleashing his bloodline with full force, observing the enormous white dragon that appeared on Jinrui's back.
It was infinitely stronger than Xuefeng's lineage projection, only a single step below Qingyi's.
Of course, it was nothing impressive when you considered that Qingyi was two whole grades below Jinrui's bloodline, an earth-grade bloodline that was superior to the transcendent grade one.
But in the end, Qingyi's strength didn't just come from his lineage and cultivation.
He wasn't the same as Jinrui. He was the heir of a primordial dragon, one of the first beings to exist, incomparable even in the heavens above all heavens.
Soon, those two draconic figures took the arena for themselves.
One of them was a dragon with black scales and four legs, a powerful body and deep purple eyes.
The other, a long, serpentine white dragon, soared elegantly through the sky, staring at Qingyi's dragon with endless hatred.
The moment the power of these two collided, all the protective arrays in the arena activated, keeping the fight within itself.
The bodies of both Qingyi and Jinrui had already disappeared, replaced by nothing but afterimages and impacts whenever their swords met, breaking the sound barrier again and again.
"Ah... you're better than I thought, hahaha." Qingyi laughed, appearing on one side of the arena.
The moment his voice fell, dozens of explosions engulfed everything around him. The floor of the arena was reduced to nothing but countless blackened craters.
Jinrui appeared on the opposite side of the arena, panting subtly, watching Qingyi with a look full of hatred.
The arena quickly recovered in front of him, the craters being erased in the blink of an eye.
"I can't say the same about you, you filthy pig! How dare you act so intimately with my Qianyao?" Jinrui growled, readying his silver saber.
The moment those words echoed through the arena, the deep golden eyes of the patriarch of the dragon people changed slightly.
He stared at his nauseated daughter and then at Jinrui's father, whose face was filled with a deep frown.
"Your son is certainly bold..." The patriarch of the dragon people muttered, a hint of dissatisfaction appearing in his voice.
Naturally, he quickly suppressed it, focusing on the battle again.
He was old, having lived much longer than anyone there could even imagine. He knew well what the younger generation was like.
Qingyi honestly didn't even pay attention to Jinrui's words, just raising one of his hands.
"There's nothing intimate between me and Young Miss Qianyao, we just had a nice, friendly duel." Qingyi lied brazenly, a lance of flame appearing in his grip.
Well, obviously, no one there needed to know what he had already seen of those huge, beautiful pale tits.

I made a few mistakes in previous chapters, just to clarify; Qingyi has his spiritual roots in the transcendent level and his lineage in the earth grade, ready to advance to the sky grade for 100 millions.
I ended up getting a little confused, hahaha.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - Tournament (06)
paragraphs: "Liar!" Jinrui roared, turning his face to Qianyao and noticing her flushed face.
How could she have such a reaction to just a friendly duel? He had also duelled her in the past and had even let her win!
Or at least, that was the lie Jinrui told himself.
Unfortunately, he couldn't think about it for long and soon had to protect himself as Qingyi hurled that spear of flame in his direction.
Jinrui raised his sword, expecting a powerful attack, but in the end, it was as if he had been hit by a fly, his body barely twitching.
"Ah... That's all you-" Before he could even finish his sentence, Jinrui had to defend himself again, a second spear hitting him twice as hard.
Then a third, a fourth, a fifth.
Each new spear forced Jinrui further and further back, and on the sixth spear, he was forced to dodge, inches away from falling off the platform.
His long white hair fluttered as the spear hit the formations on his back, engulfing his body in a sea of flames.
"Coward, fight like a man!" Jinrui roared, advancing towards Qingyi.
An icy Qi engulfed his sword and tore through the air with frightening speed, aiming exactly at the handsome young man's neck.
"If that's what you want..." Qingyi turned his body, parrying Jinrui's sword and kicking.
The soles of his boots hit the white dragon's jaw and sent it flying backwards, an explosion of blood and broken teeth leaving Jinrui's lips.
Above them both, the dragons roared at each other and, if they had real bodies, they would surely be killing each other by now.
Since they didn't, all they could do was keep roaring, pulling out every drop of hatred stored in their ancestral lineage.
Qingyi obviously didn't give Jinrui time to recover. He grabbed the heaven-defying thunder sword with full force, moving the three types of Qi through it, feeling the blade explode in heat and power.
They hadn't yet reached a battle with high-level techniques and Jinrui still had a lot in store, so Qingyi preferred to end the fight right there.
His blade tore through the air with absurd speed, breaking through the sound barrier and coming within centimeters of Jinrui's neck, opening a deep tear, but not deep enough.
The white-haired young man turned his body at a strange angle, his sword also hitting Qingyi, tearing into his back.
The handsome young man grunted in pain, but didn't let it overwhelm him. He also turned his body and swung his sword again, focusing on his opponent's neck again.
Jinrui managed to duck his head in time to avoid being completely decapitated, but even so, Qingyi's sword hit something: his horns, long, white and beautiful.
The noise was hellish, like a saw tearing through bone and steel at the same time, a heartbreaking cry of pain escaping Jinrui's lips.
"NO!" Jinrui's father rose from his seat, his eyes wide, each of the dragon people having exactly the same reaction.
Jinrui fell to his knees, his beautiful blue eyes wide as two metallic clangs echoed across the floor.
His right horn had been cut close to his scalp, while his left horn had been cut in half, his Qi leaking out of it without stopping.
"Patriarch..." Jinrui's father turned his face, his eyes meeting those of the mighty golden dragon.
But he didn't hear a word in reply for long seconds.
"The battle will continue," the golden dragon finally spoke.
The horns were one of the most important things to the dragon people. Losing them was like losing a part of their soul, their identity.
Many even went into exile because of it.
"Y-you, you... FILTHY INSECT!" Jinrui roared, getting up.
His body was filled with pure white draconic Qi, his broken horn beginning to grow at an alarming rate, as did the rest of his body.
His figure stood almost three meters tall, his muscles bulging sickeningly, even the power of his Qi exploding.
Qingyi took a step back, observing the transformation.
He had only seen something like this a few times in his life: once during his fight against the young lord of demon cult and once against the young lion beatman.
But none of these seemed to be as powerful as the one used by Jinrui. His body had changed so much that he was practically unrecognizable, covered in pure white scales.
"For my brother's death... for the shame you've put me through, I'll kill you right here!" Jinrui roared, swinging his sword in a downward slash.
Qingyi listened to those words with a cold face, also covering himself with his bloodline Qi. His Dantian burned as he put everything out.
That battle would end in that last attack.
His sword was surrounded by two types of Qi: fire and lightning. The ice Qi formed a barrier around his body and engulfed the entire arena, two blades meeting in the center of it.
For a second, time seemed to stand still before the explosion of Qi engulfed the arena entirely.
The marble platform was reduced to ashes and the spirit array shook violently.
"DIE!" Jinrui's roar of hatred and pain echoed, his sickly eyes focused on Qingyi's, cold and impassive.
"When you get to hell..." Qingyi growled, "Remember that threat. You broke that kitten's paws, I'll do a thousand times worse to you."
The moment Qingyi's voice fell, his sword sliced through Jinrui's sword.
All the spectators stood up, their vision hidden by a sea of flames, ice and lightning.
But the moment they saw the figure of the white dragon in the sky shudder, they all realized what had happened.
"Don't you dare..." Tai'Ren looked at Jinrui's father, who had already stood up, his eyes wide as the dust settled.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - It served them both right.
paragraphs: For the first time in a long, long time, Qingyi felt at real risk of death, his mind running through millions of possibilities as he raised his sword.
What on earth could he do against an ancestral emperor? He couldn't even cross enough cultivation realms to fight a true immortal!
For a brief moment, he opened the system store, looking to buy an escape talisman, but it was too late.
Jinrui's father had already drawn his sword, all his Qi falling on Qingyi as he attacked.
At that moment, something changed.
Qingyi felt a powerful, heavy figure land next to him, a higher Qi than Jinrui's father surrounding him.
It was Tai'Ren, his body enveloped in intense green Qi, his muscles expanding as his entire being blazed with power.
The whole thing lasted less than the fraction of a second, but in Qingyi's mind, it seemed to have lasted many minutes.
Jinrui's father's blade stopped a single centimeter from Qingyi's face, all remaining energy being completely eliminated by Tai'Ren's Qi.
Even without hitting Qingyi directly, that residual energy was powerful enough to seriously injure even immortal emperors.
"Looks like losing just one hand wasn't enough, huh?" Tai'Ren growled, retracting his fist before punching.
Jinrui's father's eyes widened as he tried to defend himself, but it was too late.
Tai'Ren's fist hit his face with all the force of one of the most powerful ancestral emperors in the entire immortal heaven and, in the next moment, there was silence.
Jinrui's father's body disappeared completely.

The reason for this silence was not the shock of the audience, but the total lack of any means for sound to propagate; every molecule of air had been pushed away, leaving nothing but an intense vacuum.
In the next moment, this vacuum collapsed and the bang was finally heard, a shockwave sweeping across the arena, with the ancestral emperors acting quickly to protect the audience.
Qingyi, still in shock, turned his face towards the horizon, observing a huge mountain, one of the largest in the land of beastmen, which towered majestically over the capital of the dragon people.
It was against it that Jinrui's father's body had been thrown, hitting its side at absurd speed, sinking into the resistant rock and creating a crater kilometers deep.
The whole mountain shook, the tremors spreading all the way to the capital, making the ground beneath everyone's feet tremble.
"Fuck! Blergh..." Jinrui's father vomited a gulp of blood. His clothes were torn, his face burning and his body sunk in miles of earth.
It only took him a brief moment to regain his composure and realize what had just happened.
His eyes filled with even more fury and he roared.
"TAI'REN, YOU SON OF A BITCH!" Jinrui's father's icy aura engulfed everything around him, his Qi exploding the sea of rocks, sending the thousands of tons of rock above him into the air.
The mountain that had once stood tens of kilometers high, bigger than anything Qingyi had ever seen on earth, was now reduced to just half its original size.
"Ah... looks like someone hasn't learned yet, hahahaha!" Tai'Ren laughed, ready to throw himself at his old enemy and settle their differences.
Unfortunately, he had to stop at the next moment.
Tianjin, the patriarch of the dragon people, one of only two astral body realm cultivators among the beastmen, finally made a move.
He raised a single hand, his beautiful golden eyes sweeping over everyone there.
"Enough." A single word and Tai'Ren's Qi collapsed, as did Jinrui's father's, even dozens of kilometers away.
They both fell to their knees, coughing up gulps of blood.
"You can kill yourselves another time. For now, the most important thing is that the divine beast tournament goes ahead as normal." Tianjin spoke, two guards appearing at his side.
They bowed, receiving orders to put Jinrui's father under house arrest.
Having tried to kill Qingyi was a serious act of disrespect, and Tianjin would deal with it later.
"Ugh... that sucks." Tai'Ren stood up, turning his face to Qingyi. "What's up, son-in-law? You're not going to break just with that wimp's aura, are you? Hahaha.
"Not at all, father-in-law, hahaha," Qingyi replied, getting up and wiping the blood from his lips.
His beautiful purple eyes immediately met Qianyao's, and he smiled.
"Young Miss Qianyao, are you ready? I'm still excited for us to finish that duel," Qingyi said.
The golden-eyed beauty seemed to reflect for a brief moment, her delicate fingers removing a lock of silver hair from in front of her beautiful face.
"You're hurt..." she whispered, jumping into the arena and walking towards Qingyi.
Her fingers searched for something in her space ring, and a single golden pill appeared between them.
Without hesitation, she pushed that pill into Qingyi's mouth, whose eyes widened in surprise.
"I surrender..." She blushed, looking at Qingyi's handsome face one last time before turning to her father, who was completely calm, unlike the shock carried by all the others watching the scene.
With one smooth movement, Qianyao's feet left the ground and landed next to her father.
"Ah... my son-in-law really is incomparable, hahaha... both in talent and in... well... attractiveness, HAHAHAH" Tai'Ren patted Qingyi on the shoulder.
"I'm sure this pill is rare. Go on, start healing your body, you don't want to waste any of it."
Hearing those words, Qingyi just gave a bitter little laugh and sat down cross-legged, starting to circulate his Qi.
He wasn't happy with the outcome. He wanted a serious fight with Qianyao, to test his power even more.
Jinrui had been strong and pushed him to the limit, but that wasn't the limit Qingyi wanted to face.
"Ah... I'll still have a chance..." The handsome young man sighed, watching the guards fly off into the sky with Jinrui's angry father in their arms.
Soon after, a group of doctors arrived to pick up Jinrui himself, who was unconscious, his dantian completely destroyed.
It served them both right.
May they be less horrible people in their next lives.

"Hm... Sister Ruxue said he'll be here soon," Isabel said as she helped Elize to the table, squeezing a soft, pink cream around a warm cake that had just come out of the oven.

All the girls were helping.

Ruxue, Yueli and Yunfei also helped Elize, sorting and washing the ingredients that had been gathered by the other priestesses, handing them over to Qingxue, who carefully cut them up.

After a few more hours, they finally finished everything, just in time for Ruxue's beautiful purple eyes to shine.

How the hell did those things even stay so full, round and firm, despite their weight?
Xueyao was irritated, but in the end, she just shook her head, looking at Qingyi with a flushed face.
"What are you thinking, silly girl?" He asked, briefly leaving the embrace of the three and approaching Xueyao, giving her a firm pat on the ass.

"Yours are perfect..." He said, placing a soft kiss on her lips, his free hand grabbing those pale, firm and large breasts, squeezing them until he heard that sweet, soft moan and the excited wag of her tail.

Even Linyue, who had accompanied him here, was needy, seeking as much of his touch as possible.

Well, that neediness was solved the moment she saw the large dining table, surrounded by treats she had never seen before in her life, each one looking tastier than the next, many being recipes from Earth, such as ice cream and chocolate.

But seeing how much the girls loved it, he knew it was worth it.
Apart from anything else, they could grow the necessary plants in days, harvesting the fresh fruit quickly.
The price was so high mainly because the system simply didn't have many of those seeds and from what Qingyi knew, the Earth existed in a strange way.
Something Ruxue didn't know about and the system always responded with "access denied".
'Ah... problems for the future...' Qingyi repeated to himself, then focused on the meal, observing his wives' animated conversations, which filled Linyue with questions.
The voluptuous kitten could only cringe in embarrassment next to Xueyao, two victims of the patting of the other girls, who saw them as the cutest things in the world.
A fox girl and a cat girl, both with fluffy tails and ears. They were like magnets for the cuddles of the other girls in Qingyi's harem.
Qingyi just smiled at this interaction, opening his mouth and taking a spoonful of food from Biyue, her beautiful green eyes looking away from him as she blushed.
It was still strange for her, the proud most talented daughter of the Tang family, to feed such a man.
Yet every time Qingyi opened his mouth and accepted her food, her heart burned with happiness.
When the meal was finally over and Qingyi was dragged away by the girls to the purple palace and the dual cultivation bed he had bought a long time ago, he glanced at his status screen.
Just a little longer and he would finally advance to the enlightened soul realm.

They were engulfed by the sea of flames, Khaedryss' huge body spinning in the air before emerging from the clouds of flames with a bestial roar.
She continued to rise until she was just above the height of the clouds before leveling off, her huge body moving at the speed of sound towards the huge tree on the horizon.
Honestly, Qingyi had to admit that this place was much, much bigger than it looked.
Even with Khaedryss flying at top speed, it would still take hours to get there.
At first, he thought it was something like the world of the mind, but now, he realized that it was much simpler than that, just bending space so that an entire world could fit inside a small cave.

As they flew, Qianyao just let herself relax, soon realizing something as she smelled Qingyi.
"Can I feel your lineage Qi?" she asked.
Qingyi didn't think much of it, raising his palm in front of Qianyao's face and releasing a single thread of draconic Qi.

Qingyi's own blood seemed to have changed, being at this very moment, purer than before.
"How?" Qianyao raised her face to Qingyi's, still unable to believe her
own senses.

Pills would leave traces that would only fade after many hours and well, the other possibilities were pretty easy to figure out. Qingyi smiled, already realizing what was going through Qianyao's mind.

Khaedryss' mana became agitated and she looked down, roaring towards the forest.

"Khaedryss, dive!" Qingyi ordered, releasing Qianyao so that she could move freely.

Khaedryss didn't even need to hear Qingyi's words to move, her jaw
opening in a powerful gust of flame that engulfed all the projectiles sent towards them, melting most of them.

The few that got through were already weakened, hitting Khaedryss' black scales as if they were nothing more than melted toothpicks. She descended thousands of meters in a single moment, and didn't seem interested in slowing down even a little.

hit the ground, still spitting flames.
An explosion echoed throughout the forest as the huge, tens-of-ton beast hit the ground at supersonic speed, its flames engulfing everything around it, vaporizing trees and enemies.
The ground opened up for hundreds of meters, slabs of stone and
earth splitting into deep fissures that were soon engulfed by
Khaedryss' flames.
Over an area of more than a kilometer, there was nothing left but blackened ash and cracked earth, Khaedryss' huge body resting in a crater, her jaw clenched around the neck of a beast.

trees in the area.
On its back, it carried projectiles similar to metal spears.
Qingyi and Qianyao stood just over fifty meters above the ground, watching as Khaedryss began to devour its still-living prey.
That creature was in the early stages of the false immortal realm and would certainly be a great meal for Khaedryss.

It barely made it halfway before Khaedryss launched herself towards it, her long, sharp teeth tearing through the boar's tough hide, breaking its spine.
A roar full of pain and despair escaped the boar's mouth, its throat soon filling with blood.
Khaedryss didn't finish it off, leaving its crippled body behind before moving on to the next beast.
Qingyi and Qianyao were obviously not left behind.
The handsome young man drew his heaven-defying thunder sword while the golden-eyed beauty raised a single hand, a huge sword appearing in her grip.
Above the two of them, exactly two dragons appeared.
The first, a long serpentine dragon, its golden scales glistening in the light of that false sun, its bestial face bearing a calm and gentle gaze.
The second, a dragon with black scales, purple eyes and a face filled with nothing but hatred, its roar spreading for dozens of kilometers.
Qingyi spun his body in the air, calling for one flaming spear after another, hurling them towards the hundreds of beasts that surrounded them.
The first spears were thrown at the weaker spirit beasts, while the
last three, aimed at those above the Realm of the False Immortal, hit the huge bodies with powerful explosions, severing limbs and even decapitating an unlucky one.
In all honesty, Qingyi no longer felt any pressure from beasts like that.

Every slash of the heaven-defying thunder sword, even without using any technique, destroyed everything dozens of meters in front of him, cutting through the flesh, bones and muscles of beasts with cultivations far superior to his own.
Even so, he couldn't ignore those of the True Immortal realm.
They were on a completely different level.
The heaven-defying thunder sword slashed through the neck of a giant red-butt monkey, decapitating it in a single moment before suddenly stopping.
Qingyi raised his face, an intense chill running down his spine as he turned around.
His body was engulfed by an intense aura, no less than that of a beast at the peak of the Immortal False Realm - no, even stronger.
That aura came from a beast in the realm of the true immortal.
Qingyi turned his body, a single projectile tearing through the air towards him.
It was a thorn, similar to the thorn of a plant, passing through Qingyi and grazing his cheek.
"Poison..." Qingyi spoke, touching his cheek.
He contracted his muscles, moved his Qi and in a single moment, the small wound disappeared.

On the horizon, the beast responsible for that attack finally revealed itself, crawling across the forest floor, not unlike a carnivorous plant, one of the most unique types of spirit beasts Qingyi had ever seen in his life.
"H-husband... are you going to need any help?" Qianyao asked from the other side of the battlefield, her huge sword hitting the ground with a thud, decapitating two beasts with a single movement.
"No..." Qingyi smiled, casually sidestepping as dozens more poisonous thorns flew past him.
That beast was powerful, a direct hit was sure to seriously injure him, but fortunately, it didn't seem to be very intelligent.
The kind of creature that moved only by instinct simply because it didn't have a brain developed enough to even have anything beyond instinct.
For Qingyi, honestly, this was a great opportunity.
He could finally test his new technique in real combat.
Qingyi calmed his breathing, prepared the heaven-defying thunder sword, Qi of fire, sword and lightning uniting into one around the blade, the temperature around it rising at an alarming rate.
Even dozens of meters away, trees turned to ash and everything immediately burst into flames.
With a smooth thrust, Qingyi launched himself forward, using the Heaven-Shattering Divine Slash.
The spirit beast tried to defend itself, its roots as sharp as razors flying towards Qingyi one after the other, tearing up the ground as
they moved like serpents.
But it was no use.
They turned to ash the moment they got close to Qingyi's body, the temperature around them exploding more and more.
The beast simply couldn't react as Qingyi swung the Heaven-defying Thunder Sword right at the greenish stalk, so thick it looked like a log.
The beast tried to move its Qi from the realm of the True Immortal's, but even this was unable to resist Qingyi's blade, which sank into its
body.
A desperate hiss echoed throughout the forest.
The very space in front of Qingyi seemed to tear before collapsing in a heat-filled shockwave that, like the flames of Khaedyrss, swept everything in hundreds of meters around him.
The head of the plant fell to the ground with a thud, slightly
scorched, its reddish flower rapidly losing strength.
With a soft sigh, Qingyi only turned towards Qianyao and Khaedryss,
who already seemed to have cleared the battlefield, getting rid of the
last of the beasts.
Khaedryss already wanted to start eating right there, but Qingyi decided that it was better if they just hurried along.
If those were the beasts present there during the day, he simply didn't want to deal with anything that lived there at night.
Climbing onto Khaedryss' back and storing everything in the world of Ruxue's mind, they took to the skies again, flying faster than ever, the tree on the horizon getting closer and closer.
Fortunately, there were no further problems and after about five hours of travel, Khaedryss landed at the base of the huge tree, anxiously returning to the world of the mind.
She had hunted hundreds of prey, some more powerful than those
present in the world of the mind, some even capable of wounding her.
Obviously, she was excited to eat, just as much as Qingyi was excited
to meet the matriarch.
Was an incomparable beauty with massive tits and perfect traits asking too much?

chapters.title: Chapter 388 Ye Lingxue
paragraphs: 'It really is colossal... Qingyi muttered to himself, resting one hand on the trunk of that gigantic tree as he looked up.
The top was completely swallowed up by the clouds, but he believed that it wasn't even there, not in that world.
That was probably just the base of the tree; the rest was what sprouted on top of the huge icy mountain in the outside world.
Shaking his head, Qingyi walked away.
He walked around the base with Qianyao until, finally, they found something that seemed to lead inside the trunk.
It was a small opening, apparently carved by humanoid hands, which led to a wooden staircase.
The two exchanged glances before finally entering the huge tree, their footsteps echoing down the descent.
The place was rich in Qi and the density of this energy increased more and more as they descended, to the point where they felt slightly suffocated.
That Qi was denser and purer than even the most powerful cultivation halls in the Dragon People's capital.
Suddenly, both Qingyi and Qianyao stopped.
The golden-eyed beauty moved a little closer to the handsome young man, grabbing his arm and pulling him into the embrace of her huge, heavy tits, enveloping his forearm with her round, heavy orbs.
In front of them, there was nothing but the purest, infinite darkness.
Even Qianyao's draconic eyes were unable to see through that pitch blackness, while Qingyi's could barely see ten meters ahead.
"Father has talked about this place... but he never said anything about such thick Qi," Qianyao commented next to Qingyi, who nodded
silently.
It looked strange and frightening, but fortunately there was no trace of demonic or hostile Qi there, just a peculiar form of pure energy.
After a moment's hesitation, he took a step towards the black mist, and their bodies were swallowed up.
Luckily, the mist didn't extend over too vast a region.
With just two more steps, Qingyi and Qianyao found themselves on the other side, and the world around them changed again.
A gentle breeze hit their faces, followed by a subtle, light and strangely relaxing Qi, like the scent of sweet tea in the early morning.
Qingyi raised his face, and his eyes widened as he encountered the figure who was the source of that energy.
It was a woman, reclining on her throne.
Her long hair was light green, as were her ears and fluffy tail, punctuated by subtle whiter strands.
Her beautiful eyes were softly closed and her elegant white dress totally failed to cover the two huge orbs of pale, soft flesh that
projected from her delicate torso.
The fabric fell down to just before her pink nipples, revealing large portions of pale skin from her huge, full breasts, squeezing them subtly.
The garment also showed off her delicate shoulders and part of her slender arms.
Qingyi couldn't help but shudder at such beauty, his eyes scanning every inch of her.
From the pale, creamy skin that covered those massive tits, not at all inferior to Isabel's in size and fullness, to the mature, delicate features of that beautiful, elegant face.
She was perfect in every way.
Qingyi's eyes reluctantly flicked from that huge pair of pale, creamy tits to that woman's status screen.
[Name: Ye Lingxue
Corruption: 0/100
Chastity: Intact
Lust: 1%
Talent: Incomparable genius
Reward: Incalculable
Cultivation: Third stage of the astral body realm
Spiritual roots: Astral level life spirit root
Lineage: Blood of the primordial tree of life (Astral Grade)
Constitution: Green moon body (Astral grade)
Traits: Faithful, Half-blood mythical beast, ancestral mommy, loving, caring]
As Qingyi studied the woman's statuses, her eyes subtly opened; they were green, clear and serene, staring at the two young people in front
of her.
"Long Qianyao greets Senior Ye Lingxue!" Qianyao bowed, clenching her fists. Long Qingyi did the same soon after.
Lingxue's full, rosy lips curved gently into a sweet, elegant smile.
She leaned forward, and the fabric of her dress slid a little more, revealing the pink edges of her areolas, her breasts swinging like heavy, soft pendulums.
"So you were that... vigorous young couple," Lingxue murmured in her mature, feminine voice, laden with a slight touch of sensuality. Qianyao couldn't help but blush at those words, her whole body
shuddering with embarrassment.
Had the matriarch seen everything? Even through the spatial isolation
talisman?
Sensing Qianyao's reaction, Lingxue only let out a soft giggle,
covering her lips with her right hand.
"The dragon people really have been blessed in this generation, with
two such talented young people already prepared to raise the seeds
of the next generation."
Lingxue whispered and stood up, her huge, heavy breasts heaving
heavily.
Ignoring Qianyao's blushing face, she continued:
"To be here, you were the winners of the divine beast tournament.
You are the most talented young people of this generation of beastmen, those destined to one day be at the side of the divine
beast."
Lingxue raised a hand. Her long light-green hair fluttered and her fluffy tail swayed behind her.
An intense sky-green light emerged from the ground, engulfing Qianyao and Qingyi's bodies at the same time, making them both let
out soft grunts.
That intense light was followed by a strange Qi, the likes of which Qingyi had never felt in his entire life.
The energy swept through his body, passing through his meridians, even reaching his Dantian and his mind.
Everything became clearer, from his connection with the Qi to the
speed with which his thoughts flowed.
[You have received a blessing from a nature spirit. All elemental
affinities; +500]
A single notification from the system reached Qingyi as the greenish
glow dissipated, and a deep shock hit his mind.
His affinities with ice, lightning and fire had increased by fifty
percent, and the ability to move Qi through his meridians had almost
doubled.
He turned his face to Qianyao, who seemed to have made similar
gains; her eyes trembled slightly as she looked at her own hands.
'So that was the blessing of the fox people, he thought. Even ignoring the improvement in affinity, it would already be something absurd for most high-level cultivators.
At their current level? It was simply superior to anything Qingyi had
ever imagined.
The handsome young man raised his face slightly, bowing one last time to the matriarch.
A single thought dominated his mind now.
It was time to keep his promise to Xueyao; especially since there was
no sign of demonic energy in the matriarch.
"Senior Lingxue," Qingyi called out, facing her. "I'd like to speak to you
alone."

chapters.title: Chapter 389 I am Long Qingyi
paragraphs: [Ruxue will explain everything...]
Qingyi sent a sound transmission to Qianyao, immediately sending her to the world of the mind.
Lingxue, who was watching the couple in surprise, couldn't help but feel slightly shocked.
What kind of treasure was Qingyi using?
She could no longer feel the dragon girl's presence, but she hadn't felt her aura leave the place either.
"What's the meaning of that, young man?" Lingxue stood up, but stopped the next moment.
Qingyi hesitated for a brief moment and then grabbed the handle of the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword.
An intense light engulfed the blade and a figure soon materialized beside him.
Despite the casual tone he had used before, Lingxue always kept her distance from any visitors.
That was natural. She didn't attend them out of her own desire, but out of obligation, following the tradition of her people.
However, that distance shattered the moment her eyes landed on the figure next to Qingyi.
The matriarch's face sank, as did her gaze and even her heart.
"L-Little Xue?" The matriarch called out, her voice trembling and her breathing labored.
She was an expert of the Astral Body Realm, having lived more than twice as long as even the oldest human cultivator of that level.
She should be above that kind of emotional reaction.
"Matriarch?"
Even so, when she heard that sweet, high-pitched, naive voice, she completely collapsed.
Lingxue abandoned her throne, throwing herself towards Xueyao and hugging her tightly.
"M-Matriarch..." Xueyao's eyes immediately filled with tears as she felt Lingxue's delicate, loving hands caress her long silver hair.
"I've missed you so much... I've been so lonely... If it hadn't been for husband..." Xueyao sniffled, and tears began to fall from her eyes without stopping.
"I know, darling, it was all my fault... You didn't deserve any of that," replied Lingxue, squeezing Xueyao even tighter.
Twenty thousand years of waiting.
Twenty thousand years of pain.
It was finally over; her Xueyao was back in her arms.
Lingxue let the little fox cry into her full bosom, turning her face slightly towards Qingyi, who was watching the scene with a look full of affection.
Xueyao's tears were of happiness, not sadness. How could Qingyi not be happy too?
He had fulfilled his promise. It had all been worth it.
"Little Xue is our people's most precious jewel..." Lingxue whispered, placing a kiss full of motherly love on the girl's forehead.
"Will the matriarch promise never to send Xueyao away again?" Xueyao asked, raising her tear-streaked face.
"Yes, dear... I promise..." Lingxue replied, her voice a little less shaky than before.
She placed a hand on Xueyao's face. A subtle greenish energy left her palm, flowing gently into the young woman.
At first, the voluptuous little fox was surprised, but soon began to calm down.
Her eyes slowly closed and, within moments, sleep overtook her.
Lingxue continued to stroke Xueyao's hair for a long moment before finally focusing her eyes on Qingyi.
'My little Xue really seems to have found a worthy man... she thought.
"I noticed something about the women of the fox people while I was coming to this place," Qingyi said, after a moment's hesitation.
"They were all tainted with demonic energy."
Lingxue was taken aback; her eyes studied Qingyi longingly as her Qi probed his body.
Not even the patriarch of the dragon people had been able to
perceive it. How could Qingyi?
"Twenty thousand years ago, something happened..." Lingxue stood up, holding Xueyao a little tighter.
"We were ambushed by bloody demonic cultivators.
They targeted the men of our tribe, killed them all and then planted a demonic seed in the Tree of Life, the only remaining form of
reproduction for our people..."
"A form that is only capable of giving birth to women.." Qingyi added,
and Lingxue nodded.
"Some, like Grand Elder Lanyin, were poisoned directly during the battle, while others were already born contaminated with that cursed
Qi."

"This was the curse of our people. It's what decimated our numbers, the reason that forced us to send Xueyao to mortal heaven." Lingxue pressed her hand against one of the tree's huge roots, spreading her Qi over it.
In the next instant, a powerful demonic Qi attacked her energy, shattering it quickly and leaking out for a brief moment before
ceasing.
The demon seed itself wasn't particularly powerful, but there was one crucial problem: its Qi was like a poison, corrupting anyone who tried
to destroy it.
Just breathing near it was dangerous.
Lingxue only didn't suffer terrible internal damage there because the demon seed was at the top of the tree, a long way from where they
were
"The Tree of Life is poisoned, we are poisoned... The only way to defeat it is-" Lingxue suddenly fell silent.
Why was she revealing so much to Qingyi?
He was her dear little Xue's man, the one who had brought her from
the mortal heaven and allowed them to meet again.
He was worthy, yet that wasn't his problem.
He and Xueyao couldn't stay there while their people collapsed and
risk being poisoned too.
'So that's the problem... Qingyi smiled.
He approached another tree root, touched it and circulated his Qi in
that direction.
"No, stop!" Lingxue shuddered with terror, releasing her aura with full
force in an attempt to push the young man away.
How could she face her beloved Xue if, when she woke up, her
husband was dead?
Unfortunately, it was already too late.
Demonic Qi leaked out, engulfing Qingyi's body immediately.
Lingxue's heart dropped, only to be filled with shock the next second.
Qingyi's body was... actively sucking in that Qi?
No, he was suppressing the energy, he was destroying it!
The demonic poison didn't even seem to affect him for an instant.
Even Lingxue, an expert of the Astral Body Realm, had to be extremely
careful in the face of that corruption, but Qingyi treated it with total
casualness.
Qingyi withdrew his hand, feeling his bloodline act, hunting down the
evil energy and destroying it little by little.
[This demonic Qi originates directly from the Celestial Heaven, it's not
the same as those little fish from the Mortal Heaven].
A system message appeared for Qingyi, who just nodded coldly,
taking a step towards Lingxue.
It was obvious that she hadn't told him everything, not even the
primary reason why they had been attacked, nor the clear reason why
they had sent Xueyao away.
But that didn't matter.
"I am Long Qingyi, the man chosen by Xueyao, heir to the power of a
Dragon God of the Celestial Heaven.
May the heavens curse my name, may they tremble at my existence,
but I promised to make her the happiest woman in the world, and I won't break that promise."
[Qingyi, don't defy the heavens like that, you idiot!] Ruxue's voice
echoed in his mind.
The whole space around them shook. The skies above the fox people's
capital immediately turned black.
Fortunately, the tribulation didn't fall; soon, the clouds calmed down, ignoring the man's offense.
"How powerful do I need to be to destroy this seed?"

paragraphs: The king listened to Tianshi's words, reflecting carefully.
On one hand, there was the honor and respect he had for Qingyi and Meilin, without even talking about Margareth's brave soldiers, who fought alongside him.
On the other hand, his kingdom was bankrupt.
With the enormous interest rates, what he owed to the Burning Red Pavilion was quickly piling up, becoming a debt that seemed
increasingly unpayable.
The possibility of getting rid of that debt and, on top of that, having access to more support from the Pavilion to pay for the damage caused by his brother would certainly be welcome.
After all, appeasing the massacred peoples in the north and in the royal domain would not be cheap.
After careful consideration, the king let a long, defeated sigh escape his lips as he stood up.
"Jin Tianshi, I, as the legitimate sovereign of this nation, recognize you as the rightful heir to the Burning Red Pavilion Chamber of
Commerce, which was founded and registered in my kingdom."
I hereby grant you command of a thousand royal soldiers to take immediate control of all establishments that were under the direct or indirect control of the late young lady Jin Meilin."
The king's voice echoed through the throne room, imbued with mana and spreading for kilometers.
The most honorable vassals clicked their tongues in disapproval, while those who could be bought by Tianshi flashed big smiles.
"Thank you very much, Your Majesty! I promise you won't regret it, hahaha!"
Tianshi laughed loudly, turning his back on the king without even a shred of respect.
He just needed to try a little harder. He just needed to achieve a few more victories. Then his father would recognize him as superior to his sister.
How could the Gold King not recognize Tianshi when he had taken everything from his sister, again and again?
Tianshi could already imagine himself entering his father's palace. He would be regarded by the many advisors of the incomparable Gold King with as much respect as his sister was.
Tianshi was about to leave the throne room when his footsteps suddenly stopped.
The ground beneath his feet shook violently, and it was not the tremor of his wife's heavy footsteps, which caused him so much
terror.
It was the tremor of a powerful flying ship suddenly stopping in the skies, one whose mana signature he knew well.
His heart sank and he rushed out of the royal palace, immediately raising his gaze.
Behind him, even the king had left his throne, along with all his vassals.
They were all watching the same thing: a huge, luxurious flying ship in the air, faster and more powerful than anything that had ever flown in that kingdom.
That was Jin Meilin's flying ship, and in front of it, a figure stood, floating in the air.
A young man, tall and powerful. His white robes fluttered in the wind, while his beautiful purple eyes coldly observed those below him.
Beside him stood a woman of delicate and incomparable beauty. Her beautiful dark eyes focused on Tianshi, her brother, her face no
different from that of a porcelain doll.
"Third Prince."
Qingyi's lips parted, his voice filled with murderous intent. His aura fell upon everyone there with full force, a black dragon appearing behind him.
"Or should I call you Your Majesty now? You seem to declare your disrespect for me and my wife with quite a bit of vigor."
The weaker ones fell to their knees. The two True Immortal Realm experts who served the royal family surrounded the king, protecting him with their Qi.
But even for them, it was difficult to breathe.
Qingyi's cultivation was only at the first stage of the False Immortal Realm, having recently advanced. Yet they felt as if they were dealing with someone of a completely different level.
Qingyi descended from the sky, stopping a few meters away from the king, watching him with deep coldness.
His lips parted, but before he could speak, an angry voice interrupted him.

"Who the hell do you think you are, brat? You're talking to your king!" The thunderous voice of a powerful and courageous noble echoed, untouched by the fear Qingyi had instilled in everyone there. Qingyi turned his face gently, stared at that man, and then smiled.
That was a young noble from a remote region who had not heard much about Qingyi other than legends and rumors. This was his first
time in the capital.
Qingyi raised a single hand toward the nobleman, forming a small ball of fire at the tip of his index finger.
The next moment, as he threw it, a brutal explosion echoed.
This was followed by the shrill scream of a noble woman, covered in
the blood of that young man, whose head had exploded like a
watermelon.
"Kill this bastard, I'll take care of the king!"
The True Immortal on the king's right exclaimed to the one on the
left, who advanced toward Qingyi.
The air around him boiled as he swung his sword with full power,
forcing everyone around him to retreat.
His idea was simple: attack Qingyi with full force and send him far
away, where they could fight more freely.
His sword struck Qingyi's, and in the next moment, the True
Immortal expert regretted that move.
The Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword sank into the enemy's blade as if it were nothing but butter, molten metal falling to the ground.
The expert stomped on the ground hard, trying to retreat, but it was
too late.
One slash from Qingyi's sword, and his head flew off.
In that True Immortal's mind, that clash lasted for ages. But in reality,
it happened in the blink of an eye.
The moment the melted tip of his sword touched the ground, a powerful shockwave echoed for miles, raising dust and fluttering Qingyi's clothes.
The other True Immortal was about to act when the king stepped
forward.
"Qingyi, stop! I am the King of the Blue Sea Kingdom! Do you really want to be stained with the title of regicide?"
Qingyi heard those words, pausing for a brief moment before bursting into laughter full of amusement.
"Ah..." He wiped his eyes, unable to suppress his amusement.
It took only a moment for his voice to regain its usual coldness.
"A king among kings, a king among men, or a king among maggots... Tell me, crowned worm, who do you think you are in front of me?"
